scope: Bad Moon Rising role rules whose traceability status is ROLE_LEVEL_ONLY or ENGINE_PARTIAL

statusDefinitions.non-mechanical-exception: The sentence is a table, social, Storyteller-discretion, announcement or other-edition fact with no engine state to assert; a documented, permanent exception.
statusDefinitions.mechanical-gap: The sentence has a mechanical consequence that no current test asserts (the engine may or may not implement it); it needs a test or engine change before it can be mapped.
statusDefinitions.covered-but-unmapped: A current test already asserts the sentence's behaviour, but the mapping/citation is absent or cannot reach a verified row; no product change is needed.

rules.statement: Игрок, проснувшийся ради способности, но drunk или poisoned, всё равно считается проснувшимся.
rules.reason: The new test completes a drunk Innkeeper step and shows bmrInfoForStep still counts that player as having woken.
evidence: test: src/core/engine/bmr.test.ts::the Chambermaid counts an impaired player who woke for their ability (ROLE-CHAMBERMAID-005)
code: src/core/engine/bmr.ts:bmrInfoForStep — the count filters queued role steps by done/blocked and never reads impairment.

rules.statement: В изданиях с несколькими копиями персонажа Courtier делает drunk только одного из них.
rules.reason: Multiple copies of one character are not modelled: the engine deals each character once, so the other-editions rule has no state to assert. The pinned text presents it as an other-edition example.
evidence: wiki: docs/official/wiki/Courtier.r2968.wikitext § How to Run — 'In other editions, there can be multiple copies of the same character in play.'
code: src/core/model/rules.ts:BMR — one entry per character; roleHolder returns the single holder.
gap: docs/audits/verification-gates/proposals/tb-bmr-roles.json — ROLE-COURTIER-008.

rules.statement: Devil's Advocate не может выбрать Zombuul, который регистрируется как мёртвый.
rules.reason: The new test registers the Zombuul dead and shows both bmrTargetError and completeStep refuse it.
evidence: test: src/core/engine/bmr.test.ts::a registered-dead Zombuul cannot be the Devil's Advocate target (ROLE-DEVILS-ADVOCATE-005)
code: src/core/engine/night.ts — the living-target check rejects registeredDead with error.55.

rules.statement: Прочие способности Demon продолжают работать: например, Zombuul остаётся «живым», Pukka убивает отравленного прошлой ночью, Shabaloth может regurgitate.
rules.reason: The new test blocks the Zombuul with the Exorcist and shows its first-death replacement still applies.
evidence: test: src/core/engine/bmr.test.ts::an Exorcist-blocked Zombuul still survives its first death (ROLE-EXORCIST-005)
code: src/core/engine/effects.ts:bmrCannotDie — the Zombuul first-death branch is independent of the blocked step.

rules.statement: Demon, выбранный Exorcist, всё равно просыпается, если его будит другая способность.
rules.reason: No Bad Moon Rising character wakes a Demon through a second ability, and the pinned text calls this a cross-edition interaction; the block closes only the Demon's own step, so the conditional has no reachable BMR path.
evidence: wiki: docs/official/wiki/Exorcist.r2973.wikitext § How to Run — 'This may be relevant if using the Exorcist with characters from other editions.'
code: src/core/roles/exorcist/role.ts — emits block-demon for the chosen Demon's own step.
gap: docs/audits/verification-gates/proposals/tb-bmr-roles.json — ROLE-EXORCIST-006.

rules.statement: Если Gambler drunk или poisoned, его догадка не убивает его, но способность не работает.
rules.reason: The role test asserts an impaired Gambler resolves to a suppressed ability, so a wrong guess has no effect; no separate engine survival test is needed.
evidence: test: src/core/roles/gambler/role.test.ts::an impaired Gambler reports a suppressed ability.
code: src/core/roles/gambler/role.ts — returns { kind: 'suppressed' } when impaired.
wiki: docs/official/wiki/Gambler.r3073.wikitext § Summary.

rules.statement: Godfather не убивает, если Outsider умер ночью.
rules.reason: The new test kills an Outsider at night and shows no Godfather step is queued the next night.
evidence: test: src/core/engine/bmr.test.ts::a night Outsider death does not wake the Godfather (ROLE-GODFATHER-004)
code: src/core/roles/bmr-common.ts:outsiderDiedToday — filters death.phase === 'day'.

rules.statement: Если днём умерли два Outsiders, Godfather всё равно убивает только одного игрока.
rules.reason: The new test records two day Outsider deaths, shows one step, and rejects two deaths on it with error.51.
evidence: test: src/core/engine/bmr.test.ts::two Outsider deaths in one day still give the Godfather one night kill (ROLE-GODFATHER-005)
code: src/core/roles/godfather/role.ts — actor returns one holder; outsiderDiedToday is a boolean.

rules.statement: Если Outsider днём был казнён, но не умер, Godfather не получает ночного убийства.
rules.reason: The new test executes an Outsider with a Pacifist save and shows no Godfather step is queued.
evidence: test: src/core/engine/bmr.test.ts::a saved Outsider execution does not wake the Godfather (ROLE-GODFATHER-006)
code: src/core/roles/bmr-common.ts:outsiderDiedToday — reads state.deaths, not executions.

rules.statement: Заявление должно быть определённым, слышимым и понятным всем, включая Ведущего, чтобы считаться использованием способности.
rules.reason: Whether a statement is definite, audible and understood is a table judgement with no engine state; the engine records only the Host's truth answer.
evidence: wiki: docs/official/wiki/Gossip.r1773.wikitext § Summary.
code: src/core/engine/day.ts:gossipStatement — records a boolean truth.
gap: docs/audits/verification-gates/proposals/tb-bmr-roles.json — ROLE-GOSSIP-002.

rules.statement: Ведущему рекомендуется выбирать цель, которая действительно умрёт, а не защищённую от смерти.
rules.reason: Storyteller advice about choosing a victim that will actually die; no engine state or test can encode it.
evidence: wiki: docs/official/wiki/Gossip.r1773.wikitext § How to Run.
gap: docs/audits/verification-gates/proposals/tb-bmr-roles.json — ROLE-GOSSIP-007.

rules.statement: В первую ночь Grandmother узнаёт good-игрока (Grandchild) и его персонажа.
rules.reason: The new test shows bmrInfoForStep returns the grandchild's role and seat.
evidence: test: src/core/engine/bmr.test.ts::the Grandmother learns the grandchild's character (ROLE-GRANDMOTHER-001)
code: src/core/engine/bmr.ts:bmrInfoForStep — the grandmother branch returns kind 'character'.

rules.statement: Grandchild является Townsfolk или Outsider и не узнаёт о существовании Grandmother.
rules.reason: The new test shows the grandchild has no Grandmother step and no log line naming the Grandmother.
evidence: test: src/core/engine/bmr.test.ts::the grandchild learns nothing about the Grandmother (ROLE-GRANDMOTHER-002)
code: src/core/engine/night.ts — grandmother completion rejects an evil-aligned player and a non-Townsfolk/Outsider role.

rules.statement: Если Grandchild умирает иным способом (казнь, другая способность), Grandmother не умирает.
rules.reason: The new test shows an execution and a non-Demon ability death leave the Grandmother alive, while the Demon kill takes her.
evidence: test: src/core/engine/bmr.test.ts::the Grandmother dies only when the Demon kills the grandchild (ROLE-GRANDMOTHER-004)
code: src/core/engine/bmr.ts:appendBmrConditionalSteps — matches the grandchild death cause.

rules.statement: Если Grandmother drunk или poisoned, смерть Grandchild не убивает её.
rules.reason: The impaired Grandmother is skipped by the death step and a test exists, but it carries only BMR20.
evidence: test: src/core/engine/bmr.test.ts::a drunk or poisoned Grandmother survives the grandchild's death (BMR20).
code: src/core/engine/bmr.ts:appendBmrConditionalSteps — returns when isImpaired.

rules.statement: Игроки не узнают, что Demon умер.
rules.reason: Whether players learn that the Demon died is a public-information fact; the engine enforces it only by not declaring a winner, and there is no player-facing 'learned' state to assert.
evidence: test: src/core/engine/bmr.test.ts::the Mastermind extends the game by one day after a Demon execution (BMR-MASTERMIND-01) — no winner is set when the Demon dies.
gap: docs/audits/verification-gates/proposals/tb-bmr-roles.json — ROLE-MASTERMIND-002.

rules.statement: Узнав о своей смерти, Moonchild должен публично выбрать одного живого игрока в течение минуты-двух.
rules.reason: The engine records the public living-player choice and the BMR9 tests assert the public choice, the living target and the match; only the one-to-two-minute table limit remains non-mechanical.
evidence: test: src/core/engine/bmr.test.ts::the Moonchild picks a living player after dying.
test: src/core/engine/bmr.test.ts::the Moonchild rejects a target that differs from the public choice.
wiki: docs/official/wiki/Moonchild.r1783.wikitext § How to Run.

rules.statement: Moonchild может получить совет от группы, но решение принимает сам.
rules.reason: Table advice and the player's own decision; the engine has no advice state.
evidence: wiki: docs/official/wiki/Moonchild.r1783.wikitext § Summary.
gap: docs/audits/verification-gates/proposals/tb-bmr-roles.json — ROLE-MOONCHILD-004.

rules.statement: Когда казнён good-игрок, Ведущий выбирает, умирает он или остаётся жив.
rules.reason: The survival is a Storyteller choice; the engine exposes it as a host-choice flag and offers only the legal option.
evidence: test: src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::the Pacifist survival flag is legal only for a good target with a sober Pacifist (BMR-PACIFIST-01).
code: src/core/roles/pacifist/role.ts — the execution capability returns 'survives'.

rules.statement: Группа узнаёт только факт казни и факт выживания, но не причину.
rules.reason: The engine stores the Pacifist survival as secret and the execution log marks the execution prevented; the BMR-PACIFIST-01 test asserts both, so the group learns the fact without the cause.
evidence: test: src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::the Pacifist survival flag is legal only for a good target with a sober Pacifist (BMR-PACIFIST-01).
wiki: docs/official/wiki/Pacifist.r2601.wikitext § Summary.

rules.statement: Если казнённый остаётся жив, это всё равно считается казнью дня.
rules.reason: A surviving execution still records the day's execution; the generic execution test and the Pacifist survival path prove it, with no Pacifist mapping.
evidence: test: src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::execution is an execution event, not automatically a death (SYS-WINS-01).
test: src/core/engine/bmr.test.ts::a good player who survives the Mastermind extra-day execution still loses (BMR-MASTERMIND-01) — the Pacifist spares the execution and the day still resolves.

rules.statement: Pacifist не влияет на изгнание Traveller.
rules.reason: Traveller exile is not modelled; the rule states a non-effect for a mechanic outside the supported scripts.
evidence: code: no Traveller/exile path in src/core/engine.
gap: docs/audits/verification-gates/proposals/tb-bmr-roles.json — ROLE-PACIFIST-004.

rules.statement: Обычно достаточно запускать способность примерно раз за игру; можно чаще или, редко, никогда.
rules.reason: Storyteller advice about how often to use the ability; no engine behaviour.
evidence: wiki: docs/official/wiki/Pacifist.r2601.wikitext § How to Run.
gap: docs/audits/verification-gates/proposals/tb-bmr-roles.json — ROLE-PACIFIST-005.

rules.statement: Воскрешённый игрок получает способность обратно, включая уже использованную "once per game"; способность "first night only" срабатывает немедленно.
rules.reason: A resurrected player regains a used once-per-game ability and a first-night ability wakes again; the tests exist as BMR10, not under an engine rule ID.
evidence: test: src/core/engine/bmr.test.ts::a resurrected player regains a used once-per-game ability (BMR10).
test: src/core/engine/bmr.test.ts::a regurgitated start-knowing player wakes to use the ability again (BMR10).
code: src/core/engine/bmr.ts:resurrectPlayer — clears RESTORED_ON_RESURRECTION and restores the wake.
gap: docs/audits/verification-gates/proposals/tb-bmr-roles.json — ROLE-PROFESSOR-004.

rules.statement: Игрок, убитый Pukka, остаётся poisoned в момент смерти; это влияет на его смертельную способность.
rules.reason: The cited test already asserts the delayed death is recorded with impaired: true, so the victim is still poisoned when it dies; the shared death consumer reads that flag.
evidence: test: src/core/engine/bmr.test.ts::the Pukka poisons immediately and kills the previous victim next night (BMR-PUKKA-01, BMR-PUKKA-04)
code: src/core/roles/pukka/role.ts — poison and delay-death land on the same target.

rules.statement: Если Sailor выбирает себя, он теряет защиту от смерти до момента, когда снова станет sober.
rules.reason: The Sailor test asserts a drunk or poisoned Sailor dies and a restored Sailor is protected again; a self-choice makes the Sailor drunk, so the loss of protection is exercised.
evidence: test: src/core/engine/bmr.test.ts::the Sailor cannot die while healthy but dies while poisoned or drunk.
test: src/core/engine/bmr.test.ts::the Sailor makes the chosen recipient drunk until dusk and supports choosing themself (BMR-SAILOR-01, BMR-SAILOR-02).
wiki: docs/official/wiki/Sailor.r1768.wikitext § Summary.

rules.statement: Если Sailor выбирает мёртвого игрока, Ведущий предлагает выбрать другого.
rules.reason: The target restriction rejects a dead player and the BMR-CHAMBERMAID-03 test asserts that rejection; the offer of another player remains a table interaction.
evidence: test: src/core/engine/bmr.test.ts::BMR target restrictions reject dead, self and evil targets (BMR-CHAMBERMAID-03).
wiki: docs/official/wiki/Sailor.r1768.wikitext § Summary.

rules.statement: На рассвете Ведущий объявляет, кто умер и кто вернулся к жизни, не называя причин.
rules.reason: The dawn announcement of deaths and returns without causes is Storyteller speech; the engine records the events but has no announcement contract for this role.
evidence: wiki: docs/official/wiki/Shabaloth.r1790.wikitext § How to Run.
gap: docs/audits/verification-gates/proposals/tb-bmr-roles.json — ROLE-SHABALOTH-006.

rules.statement: Regurgitation рекомендуется применять редко — примерно раз за игру, максимум дважды.
rules.reason: Storyteller advice about how often to regurgitate; no engine behaviour.
evidence: wiki: docs/official/wiki/Shabaloth.r1790.wikitext § How to Run.
gap: docs/audits/verification-gates/proposals/tb-bmr-roles.json — ROLE-SHABALOTH-007.

rules.statement: Ведущий может в любой момент убить Tinker.
rules.reason: The Storyteller decides when, and whether, the Tinker dies; the engine exposes the death as a host-choice outcome (ENGINE_PARTIAL) rather than a computed effect.
evidence: test: src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::a sober Tinker dies from an ability death during the day and the night (BMR-TINKER-01).
test: src/core/roles/tinker/role.test.ts::the Tinker's step resolves to nothing, healthy or impaired: the host marks the death (BMR-TINKER-01).
mapping: docs/audits/verification-gates/proposals/tb-bmr-roles.json — ROLE-TINKER-001 → BMR-TINKER-01 (host-choice).

rules.statement: Если Tinker умирает днём, Ведущий немедленно объявляет смерть.
rules.reason: The immediate daytime announcement is Storyteller speech; the engine records the ability death only.
evidence: test: src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::a sober Tinker dies from an ability death during the day and the night (BMR-TINKER-01) — the death record only.
gap: docs/audits/verification-gates/proposals/tb-bmr-roles.json — ROLE-TINKER-002.

rules.statement: Если Tinker умирает ночью, смерть отмечается и объявляется на рассвете вместе с другими.
rules.reason: The dawn announcement of a night death is Storyteller speech; the death record exists but not an announcement contract.
evidence: test: src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::a sober Tinker dies from an ability death during the day and the night (BMR-TINKER-01) — the death record only.
gap: docs/audits/verification-gates/proposals/tb-bmr-roles.json — ROLE-TINKER-003.

rules.statement: Tinker не может умереть от своей способности, пока защищён от смерти.
rules.reason: A protected Tinker does not die from the ability, and an asserting test exists, but the only Tinker engine row is host-choice, so the mapped sentence cannot rise above ENGINE_PARTIAL.
evidence: test: src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::a protected Tinker does not die from their ability (BMR-TINKER-01).
mapping: docs/audits/verification-gates/proposals/tb-bmr-roles.json — ROLE-TINKER-004 → BMR-TINKER-01; BMR-TINKER-01 is host-choice.

rules.statement: Ведущий может никогда не убивать Tinker; это делает его подозрительным.
rules.reason: The host may never kill the Tinker; the absence of a host choice is not an assertable event.
evidence: gap: docs/audits/verification-gates/proposals/tb-bmr-roles.json — ROLE-TINKER-005.

rules.statement: Ведущему рекомендуется не убивать Tinker, если это приведёт к окончанию игры.
rules.reason: Storyteller advice about not ending the game; no engine behaviour.
evidence: wiki: docs/official/wiki/Tinker.r1782.wikitext § How to Run.
gap: docs/audits/verification-gates/proposals/tb-bmr-roles.json — ROLE-TINKER-006.

rules.statement: Если Tinker drunk или poisoned, у него нет способности, но Ведущий всё равно может изображать её.
rules.reason: The mechanical half (an impaired Tinker does not die) is asserted by BMR-TINKER-01; the pinned Tinker.r1782 page has no drunk, poisoned or pretend sentence, so the remaining clause has no source.
evidence: test: src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::a drunk or poisoned Tinker does not die on their night step, as by day (BMR-TINKER-01).
wiki: docs/official/wiki/Tinker.r1782.wikitext § Summary — no impairment or pretend sentence.

rules.statement: Если казнён мёртвый игрок, он не умирает снова, поэтому Zombuul всё равно просыпается, если никто не умер.
rules.reason: The new test executes an already dead player, shows deathId is null, and shows the Zombuul wakes and kills.
evidence: test: src/core/engine/bmr.test.ts::executing a corpse leaves the Zombuul free to attack (ROLE-ZOMBUUL-006)
code: src/core/roles/bmr-common.ts:anyoneDiedToday — reads real deaths only.
